values: Live read-only desktop inspection - 12 Oct 2026 - https://athlon.co.in
No forms, payments, or mutations tested
Dashboard tool carousel duplicates sidebar navigation
Observed across workspace dashboards; consumes first viewport and repeats destinations.
Remove generic carousel on desktop; retain sidebar as canonical navigation and show max four contextual pinned actions.
Static-looking event/activity content appears beside live zero totals
A manager cannot distinguish live records from sample content.
Use only live data or explicit empty/error/sample states.
Cards do not scale for filtering, comparing, or bulk management.
Make table/list default; keep card view optional.
Roster/batch state transition lacks a unified resolved-state contract
Initial Loading labels were observed before useful empty state.
Use bounded skeleton, error/retry, then explicit zero state.
Calendar grid needs scalable desktop ergonomics
Strong grid foundation, but high facility volume needs fixed headers/legend and constrained scroll.
Freeze time/header, persistent legend, non-color state cues.
Booking ledger displays full customer phone numbers
List view makes phone data easy to shoulder-surf or expose in screenshots.
Mask by default; reveal in authorized detail.
Personal operations and marketplace discovery compete
Upcoming personal actions have similar weight to explore content.
Put My Day and action queue first; demote discovery.
Remove member is repeated as a direct table action
Prominent destructive controls create visual noise and accidental-action risk.
Dense sidebars require robust collapsed-mode behavior
Grouping is good but needs reliable tooltip, focus, active-state, and keyboard validation.
Too many metrics/features appear before a priority queue
Limit KPI strip then show prioritized operational work.
